liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (3 reviews): Reviewer finds Stella Blue among the most emotional moments the Dead ever played; Reviewer calls it the best Stella Blue ever; it moved them to tears [9][10][13]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): The Victim, Scarlet, Fire sequence pleased the crowd strongly, on Jerry's birthday, which the band rarely played; Fans had waited all tour for Scarlet > Fire and finally got it on Jerry's birthday [6][7]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this the funkiest, weirdest Watchtower heard, with Vince's keyboard work standing out; Reviewer points to Watchtower, Satisfaction and Stella Blue as the highlights that explain the show [8][11]
- **(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction** (2 reviews): Followed Stella Blue; the first Satisfaction since 6/18/92, and it was played with great energy; Reviewer says Satisfaction was played for the Stones, who began their tour that day [7][12]
- **Liberty** (1 review): Reviewer considers this the best Liberty they have heard [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mickey Mouse Theme**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [17]
- **Adams Family Theme**: back after 522 archived shows (2494 days); rare: 3 archived performances [17]
- **Childhood's End**: rare: 13 archived performances [17]
- **(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction**: back after 151 archived shows (774 days) [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-08-01.schoeps.wklitz.96433.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 2.29/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd94-08-01.neumann.nawrocki.12522.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 174 min; rated 4.45/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sound quality is strong, given the microphones used [15]
- **gd94-08-01.set2-sbd.georges.1026.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 135 min; rated 3.94/5 by 33 [4]. Said about its sound: The soundboard recording makes this a worthwhile addition to a collection [6]
- **gd1994-08-01.141177.Icmc5-mk4.IIFOB-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 175 min; rated 1/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer saw many Palace shows; this one was not the best but felt especially special, falling on Jerry's birthday [6]
- A huge birthday card was available for fans to sign at entry; the arena was ice cold; Jerry wore a dark maroon t-shirt [12]
- First set was weak while the second set was outstanding; reviewer attended every show from Highgate to Giants that summer [7]
- Strongest set of the tour's last three nights; first show on August 1 since 1982; East coast got Fire for the summer [12]
- Reviewer rates it pretty good for that summer; the Palace was the only indoor venue of the tour [15]
- Reviewer thinks the Stella Blue from 3-21-94 is even better than this one [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-08-01.schoeps.wklitz.96433.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4's>Rbox>Technics SV-MD1 [1]
- **gd94-08-01.neumann.nawrocki.12522.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Doug Nawrocki; source: Audience: Neumann TLM 170i's [2]. Also: Recorded with Neumann TLM 170i cardioid mics into a modified D10 Pro II; Transferred from DA-P1 via Audiophile 2496 into Sound Forge 6, downsampled 48 to 44.1 with anti-aliasing, then CDWave and mkwACT by Doug Nawrocki [2]
- **gd94-08-01.set2-sbd.georges.1026.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD> CD> EAC [4]
- **gd1994-08-01.141177.Icmc5-mk4.IIFOB-mk4.ebel.flac1644**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/44.1 Source Info:Set #1: TS? Schoeps CMC5 Mk4->Oade P/S-> Sony D10 Pro II-> DATSet #2: FOB Schoeps MK4-> Reutelhuber P/S-> DAT (Ace Cubby)Transfer… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by D.King Gallery: [Reonegro Grateful Dead 8/1/1994 Jerry's Birthday Auburn Hills MI Backstage Pass](https://www.dking-gallery.com/store/Dead_Pass_940801.html) [18]
